text:
maya.marketing: quick sync — marketing needs final changelog bullets + canonical docs links for the Friday press window at 11:30am PST. also prepping webinar page and benchmark callout. who can confirm final numbers and rollout timing?

devin.eng: I can grab the changelog bullets. putting a short list together now — will post in 10. do we want the microbench numbers (p99 latency, tok/s) or higher-level cost/latency comparisons?

sara.docs: can you also flag which docs pages are safe to publish? we have draft content on /docs/preview that still needs a couple examples. want final links instead of preview links.

elena.prod: from GTM side we need: 1) changelog bullets (3), 2) docs canonical links, 3) benchmark soundbite (one sentence + appendix link), 4) recommended rollout sentence (canary -> scale).

maya.marketing: ideal — short bullets for the press blurb, and an appendix link for the benchmark deep-dive. webinar signup needs a hero stat (e.g., "2–3x throughput at X latency vs baseline") — leave the exact wording to eng.

devin.eng: draft changelog bullets: 
- "Added adaptive batching + KV-cache optimization for shorter prefixes; 20% lower token cost on retrieval-style workloads."
- "Introduced first-class streaming improvements for lower p99 on interactive chat."
- "New model routing fallback policy to improve reliability during regional capacity events."

sara.docs: nice. I'll convert those into plain-language snippets for docs. can you add a tiny inline example for the streaming change? 1-line code sample is enough.
devin.eng: sure — snippet: ```js
const stream = await Redwood.stream({model: 'rwd-medium', prompt});
stream.on('token', t => process.stdout.write(t));
```

ravi.sre: for rollout timing: suggest canary at 11:30am PST (same as press) for 30m on dedicated region us-west-2 with 5% traffic, then 30m at 25%, then 60m at 100% if no errors. auto-fallback to previous model if error rate > 1.5%.

elena.prod: that schedule works. marketing will note "staged rollout during press window" and include fallback note. need an ops link to the runbook.

ravi.sre: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/release-canary-ops (please use internal link in the appendix).

maya.marketing: for the hero stat — do we have a headline-safe benchmark? something like "up to 2.1k tokens/sec on a single p4d with 30% lower cost-per-token vs baseline" — is that defensible?
devin.eng: defensible with context. measured on internal convo workload (avg seq 128), 2.1k tok/s sustained, p99 latency 120ms for single-request streaming. i'd add "on representative conversation workload" as the qualifier.
sara.docs: I'll add an appendix page: /docs/benchmarks/prelaunch-1915 with raw numbers and graphs. will generate a shareable internal preview link and a canonical URL for publish.

maya.marketing: perfect. can you post the final docs canonical link and the internal preview link here by EOD? marketing wants to lock the press blurb and webinar page tonight.

devin.eng: posting raw benchmark appendix (internal): https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/1915-benchmarks. Changelog bullets are above — let me know if wording needs softening.

sara.docs: internal preview: https://preview.docs.redwood/1915-prelaunch. canonical (to publish in Friday post): https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/prelaunch-1915

elena.prod: question — webinar timing — we are following press at 12:30pm PST or same time? current plan was 12:00pm. we need 1h buffer after press for promo links to propagate.

maya.marketing: push webinar to 12:30pm PST. that gives ops time to verify canary. update marketing calendar + invite now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 11:30am PST -> us-west-2 -> 5% traffic for 30m. Canary owner: ravi.sre.

ravi.sre: i'll monitor. alert channel #eng-oncall and #incidents if >0.5% errors during ramp.

maya.marketing: last asks: 1) final short changelog (3 bullets) in plain copy for press (one-liners), 2) canonical docs links, 3) approved hero stat and the appendix link for the benchmark. will we be able to post all three by 7pm PT?
devin.eng: yes, changelog one-liners posted above — copy away.
sara.docs: canonical + preview links posted — will update examples tonight.

elena.prod: I updated the webinar event to 12:30pm PST and added the hero stat options. marketing: pick one and paste final copy here for sign-off.

maya.marketing: choosing: "Up to 2.1k tokens/sec on representative convo workloads with 30% lower token cost vs baseline — see appendix." final press blurb will include that + the three changelog bullets + docs canonical link.

sara.docs: noted. preparing final publishable doc with examples and a short FAQ for the webinar.

maya.marketing: excellent — thanks everyone. i'll post the press blurb draft by 6:45pm PT for final thumbs. :raised_hands:
